statements.t: “With Phase 3 AURORA data expected in the first quarter of 2027, our focus this quarter remains on execution, both in the clinic and in preparing the organization for a commercial launch,” said Carsten Brunn, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer of Cartesian.
“Ahead of our anticipated BLA submission in mid-2027, we have expanded our medical affairs and commercial teams to drive launch readiness.
Beyond MG, we look forward to data from our TRITON and HELIOS trials expected in 2027 as we work to bring Descartes-08 to more patients with autoimmune diseases.”
The Company plans to evaluate a subset of patients from the trial to determine the potential path to a pivotal trial in myositis.
The Company’s current cash resources on hand are expected to support planned operations, including completion of the ongoing Phase 3 AURORA trial, into 2028.
